# Recorded arXiv past-week pages

Recorded on 2026-11-06 04:07 UTC from GitHub Actions, unmodified response bodies of
`https://arxiv.org/list/<category>/pastweek?show=2000` (with a cache-busting `_=`
value). They cover the announcements of 2026-10-30, 11-02, 11-03, 11-04 and 11-05.

- `cond-mat.supr-con.html`: 53 entries (26, 5, 11, 5, 6 per day; 19 cross-lists).
- `cond-mat.mes-hall.html`: 181 entries (61, 27, 56, 21, 16 per day).

The 2026-11-03 announcement was never ingested by the daily run because the CDN
served the 2026-11-02 page; the catch-up test recovers it from these pages.
